title: Hyper-Ramanujan (HR) Closed-Form Radical Approximations for 2D Ellipse Circumference and 3D Triaxial Ellipsoid Surface Area
description: Machine-verified symbolic and high-precision numerical research suite introducing the Hyper-Ramanujan (HR) family of closed-form single-radical approximations for the 2D ellipse circumference (HR-7-Int, HR-6B, HR-8B, HR-8P, HR-6M) and 3D triaxial ellipsoid surface area (HR-3D-8P, HR-3D-10P) by Sebastian Oertel (@CodiBasti).
